Name: ScytheDeletable
Author: MniShark
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Scythe Deletable[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]镰刀可删除[/size][/b][/center]

[line]

[b]Description[/b]
Scythe Deletable is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that lets you get rid of outdated scythes. Normally, tools cannot be trashed. This mod changes that: if you own a better scythe, the lower-tier one becomes trashable just like a regular item. No configuration needed.

[b]描述[/b]
镰刀可删除是一个轻量的便利性模组，让你可以处理掉过时的镰刀。原版游戏中工具无法丢进垃圾桶，本模组改变了这一点：如果你拥有更高级的镰刀，低级镰刀就会像普通物品一样可以丢弃。无需任何配置。

[line]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Normal Scythe:[/b] Can be trashed if you own a Golden Scythe or Iridium Scythe.[/*]
[*][b]Golden Scythe:[/b] Can be trashed if you own an Iridium Scythe.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Scythe:[/b] Highest tier, cannot be trashed.[/*]
[*][b]No configuration needed.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]功能[/b]
[list]
[*][b]普通镰刀：[/b] 拥有金镰刀或铱镰刀时，可以丢进垃圾桶。[/*]
[*][b]金镰刀：[/b] 拥有铱镰刀时，可以丢进垃圾桶。[/*]
[*][b]铱镰刀：[/b] 最高级，无法丢弃。[/*]
[*][b]无需配置。[/b][/*]
[/list]
